Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write code that submits an audio file for batch transcription using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 2 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 3 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 6 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import time
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def submit_batch_transcription(
    audio_file_uri: str,
    job_name: str,
    output_bucket: Optional[str] = None,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    media_format: Optional[str] = None,
    vocabulary_name: Optional[str] = None,
    settings: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = 10,
    timeout_seconds: int = 3600,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Submit an audio file to Amazon Transcribe for batch transcription and wait for completion.

    Args:
        audio_file_uri: S3 URI for the audio file, e.g. s3://bucket/path/file.mp3
        job_name: Unique transcription job name.
        output_bucket: Optional S3 bucket for transcription output.
        language_code: Language code for transcription.
        media_format: Optional media format, e.g. mp3, mp4, wav, flac, ogg, webm.
        vocabulary_name: Optional custom vocabulary name.
        settings: Optional transcription settings dict passed through to Amazon Transcribe.
        poll_interval_seconds: Seconds between job status checks.
        timeout_seconds: Maximum seconds to wait for completion.

    Returns:
        A dict containing job metadata and, when completed, transcription text and result URI.
    """
    transcribe = boto3.client("transcribe")

    start_kwargs = {
        "TranscriptionJobName": job_name,
        "Media": {"MediaFileUri": audio_file_uri},
        "LanguageCode": language_code,
    }
    if output_bucket:
        start_kwargs["OutputBucketName"] = output_bucket
    if media_format:
        start_kwargs["MediaFormat"] = media_format
    if vocabulary_name:
        start_kwargs["VocabularyName"] = vocabulary_name
    if settings:
        start_kwargs["Settings"] = settings

    try:
        transcribe.start_transcription_job(**start_kwargs)
    except ClientError as e:
        error_code = e.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "")
        if error_code != "ConflictException":
            raise

    deadline = time.time() + timeout_seconds
    last_response = None

    while True:
        try:
            response = transcribe.get_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_name)
        except (BotoCoreError, ClientError):
            raise

        last_response = response
        job = response.get("TranscriptionJob", {})
        status = job.get("TranscriptionJobStatus")

        if status == "COMPLETED":
            transcript_uri = (
                job.get("Transcript", {}).get("TranscriptFileUri")
                or job.get("TranscriptFileUri")
            )
            transcript_text = None
            if transcript_uri:
                try:
                    import urllib.request
                    import json

                    with urllib.request.urlopen(transcript_uri) as resp:
                        payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                    transcript_text = (
                        payload.get("results", {})
                        .get("transcripts", [{}])[0]
                        .get("transcript")
                    )
                except Exception:
                    transcript_text = None

            return {
                "job_name": job.get("TranscriptionJobName", job_name),
                "status": status,
                "transcript_file_uri": transcript_uri,
                "transcript_text": transcript_text,
                "raw": response,
            }

        if status == "FAILED":
            return {
                "job_name": job.get("TranscriptionJobName", job_name),
                "status": status,
                "failure_reason": job.get("FailureReason"),
                "raw": response,
            }

        if time.time() >= deadline:
            return {
                "job_name": job.get("TranscriptionJobName", job_name),
                "status": status,
                "error": "timeout",
                "raw": last_response or response,
            }

        time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    audio_uri = os.environ.get("AUDIO_FILE_URI", "")
    name = os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_JOB_NAME", "batch-transcription-job")
    bucket = os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_OUTPUT_BUCKET")
    media_fmt = os.environ.get("AUDIO_MEDIA_FORMAT")

    result = submit_batch_transcription(
        audio_file_uri=audio_uri,
        job_name=name,
        output_bucket=bucket,
        media_format=media_fmt,
    )
    print(result)
